scope: Source-term research, not legal clearance. Current pages do not prove historical record-level rights. Collection licenses are distinct from individual-content licenses. Fair use is not a license.

nvd.published_terms: NIST data terms plus CVE Terms of Use where applicable
nvd.action: Identify NIST-authored versus contributed CVE content; preserve applicable copyright/license notices and attribution. CVE link is an official archive. Do not blanket-license all contributions as public domain.

cisa-kev.action: Bind the catalog/version to the official CC0 statement; distinguish linked third-party works and protected marks. Preserve original row labels separately.

mitre-attack.action: Bind the ingested release to its license and include MITRE copyright and permission notices; current master is evidence of current terms only.

mitre-cwe.action: Preserve the applicable MITRE copyright designation and license notice; bind the source release.

capec.action: Preserve the applicable MITRE copyright designation and license notice; bind the source release.

sigma.action: Resolve legacy LGPL-2.1 label against the actual ingested revision. Preserve rule authors, rule/source URI, and DRL text or link where applicable.

stackexchange.published_terms: CC-BY-SA-2.5 / CC-BY-SA-3.0 / CC-BY-SA-4.0, per contribution revision
stackexchange.action: Recover each question/answer revision's authors, attribution URLs and license. A question date or thread-wide CC-BY-SA-4.0 label cannot establish all component rights. Preserve ShareAlike obligations.

reddit.action: Obtain applicable permission/agreement or a reviewed legal basis for this public redistribution; a user's grant to Reddit is not a general grant to this project.

cloudtrail-flaws.action: Locate the original log publisher's license or permission. Public availability and the legacy Public Domain (flaws.cloud) label are insufficient evidence.

arxiv.published_terms: Per paper/version; preserve the exact supplied license
arxiv.action: Bind the extracted paper version to its license, authors, title and source URL. The default arXiv license is not a general third-party republication grant. Review NC, ND, SA and legacy public-domain labels separately. Metadata CC0 does not license full text.

primus-fineweb.action: Restore page URL and original page license/permission evidence. ODC-By does not license individual underlying web-page copyright. Source inventory has no supplied page-license values.

redsage-cfw.action: Restore page URL and original page license/permission evidence. ODC-By does not license individual underlying web-page copyright. Source inventory has no supplied page-license values.

youtube-commons.published_terms: Dataset card CC-BY-4.0; underlying video grant must be checked separately
youtube-commons.action: Restore video URL/ID, channel identity, title and original license string from the exact selected row. Verify the applicable license version and attribution/changes. A generic reuse-allowed string does not establish a historical version; missing licenses remain unresolved.
